body:
John Paul II Critical Hit Particles texture pack

This resource pack modifies Minecraft’s default critical hit particles to display the face of John Paul II, bringing a unique touch to your gameplay experience.

Installation Instructions:

Download the resource pack.

Place the .zip file in your Minecraft's resourcepacks folder located at %APPDATA%/.minecraft/resourcepacks.

Launch Minecraft, go to Options, then Resource Packs.

Select the John Paul II Critical Hit Particles pack and click "Done".

Enjoy the new particles during your critical hits!

Features:

Replaces the default critical hit particles with the face of John Paul II.

Compatible with other resource packs and does not require any external mods.

It's funny

FAQ:

Q: Does this work with my existing resource pack?
A: Yes, this resource pack works with any resource pack you’re using, as it only modifies particle effects.

Q: Do I need any mods to use this resource pack?
A: No, this is purely a resource pack and does not require any mods to function.
